reuse.why: Introduces one getMonthActionCategories selection used by setZero and the averages and reuses getCategoryAverage/getBudgetData, though copyPreviousMonth keeps deciding the rule on its own row data.

duplication.why: Removes the three copied category queries and the copied average loops; the hidden/template rule still exists twice, once in SQL and once as JS checks in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Selection helper and actions live together in server/budget/actions.ts where the month-wide actions already are.

scope.why: Beyond the rule change, it rewires set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg from setNMonthAvg onto the 3-month loop, an unrequested consolidation that changes how those actions compute.

maintainability.why: A named selection function and a single averaging helper make the code easier to own, with the copyPreviousMonth path as the remaining divergence.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No pre-existing selection abstraction is bypassed; copyPreviousMonth works off getBudgetData as before.

disguised_duplication.where: The template/hidden check in copyPreviousMonth openly re-states the getMonthActionCategories WHERE clause in JS.

one_place.where: The rule lands in getMonthActionCategories (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) but copyPreviousMonth applies it separately via its own hidden/group_hidden/goal_def checks on getBudgetData rows.
